milestone: M63 Runtime Product Gap Closure Evidence

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Records bounded closure evidence for a runtime-selected Product DoD gap after its selected-gap-derived continuation completes and is accepted.

Requires explicit selected-gap closure authorization and fresh source decision, product evidence, selected gap, objective, acceptance, terminal, and completion-closure fingerprints before ledger mutation.
Persists one bounded HeadlessRunSelectedProductGapClosureRecorded event and replays it without duplicate mutation.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with runtime_permission_enforcement and progress_visualization support.
answers.new_capability: Existing headless.run.drive can bind an accepted selected-gap-derived objective completion to one selected Product DoD gap closure evidence item, and product evidence matrix derivation can consume that evidence so the closed gap is not selected again.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M62.1 selected a Product DoD gap and M62.2 carried that selected-gap provenance into continuation and journey admission, but no runtime-owned feedback edge proved that the selected gap was later resolved.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could repeatedly select and continue from the same Product DoD gap without a durable way for accepted downstream work to close that gap in later product evidence.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M62.1 gap selection and M62.2 selected-gap provenance binding: this phase records accepted closure evidence and changes matrix completion behavior after the selected work completes.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive request/result and matrix path are extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The change adds structured closure evidence and matrix consumption, not a summary, digest, report, history, readiness, inspection, preview, or verdict wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime now rejects unauthorized or stale selected-gap closure requests before mutation, records one bounded closure event for valid accepted selected-gap-derived completions, replays it idempotently, and lets a later matrix treat that exact selected gap as closed.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can converge Product DoD evidence from runtime facts: selected gap to continuation, accepted completion, closure evidence, matrix derivation, and product-complete decision on a later boundary.
answers.milestone_progress: Creates the core M63 feedback edge needed to stop planning the same selected Product DoD gap after its accepted closure.

reject_when: closure accepted without selected-gap-derived objective provenance
matrix derivation still selects the closed gap
missing behavior tests for closure replay and stale fingerprint denial
automatic provider, tool, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: Manifest updates select the current M63.1 value gate; no guard engine logic is changed.

exit_criteria: headless.run.drive accepts one authorized selected_product_gap_closure envelope on an accepted selected-gap-derived objective completion boundary
Closure evidence binds source product decision, source product evidence, selected remaining gap, product objective, accepted completion, terminal completion, and completion closure fingerprints
Stale or conflicting selected-gap closure fingerprints are denied before mutation
Closure replay is deterministic and does not duplicate HeadlessRunSelectedProductGapClosureRecorded events
Product evidence matrix derivation consumes valid closure evidence and does not select the closed gap as open
A product_complete decision can be admitted on the continuation boundary when closure evidence resolves the only open required Product DoD gap
No new JSON-RPC method, report, readiness, inspection, digest, history, shell/git/network/service action, provider/tool execution, or workspace mutation is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_selects_remaining_product_dod_gap_and_decides covers selected-gap continuation provenance, accepted continuation completion, selected gap closure recording, stale closure fingerprint denial, matrix consumption of closure evidence, product_complete after closure, replay behavior, and duplicate-free closure/matrix/decision ledger events.
Rust cargo check validates the new HeadlessRunSelectedProductGapClosure request/result types and no-eligible checkpoint post-progress recovery needed for closure drives.

VSIX runtimeClient protocol tests accept bounded selected_product_gap_closure request/result shapes and reject malformed authorization, fingerprints, raw fields, and invalid closure evidence next actions.

accepted_capability: Runtime-selected Product DoD gaps can be closed by accepted selected-gap-derived objective completion evidence.
Product evidence matrix derivation can consume closure evidence so the same selected gap is not selected again as open work.
Product completion decisions can use the closure-consumed matrix on the later continuation boundary.
behavior_evidence: Focused Rust behavior test exercises closure success, replay, stale denial, matrix consumption, and product_complete after closure.
VSIX validator test covers the bounded transport shape without moving closure policy into the extension.
safety_boundary: Requires explicit selected gap closure authorization.
Revalidates current accepted completion, terminal completion, completion closure, source decision, source product evidence, selected gap, and product objective fingerprints before closure mutation.
Denies stale, malformed, missing, or conflicting closure evidence before matrix or decision mutation.
Does not expose raw policy, evidence artifact, prompt, provider, stdout, stderr, command, environment, path, or secret content.
Does not run providers, tools, shell, git, network, services, or workspace mutation.
non_goals: Does not add a new JSON-RPC method or wrapper surface.
Does not create, delete, or mutate workspace files.
Does not add a multi-gap closure transaction.
Does not auto-close gaps without explicit authorization and accepted selected-gap-derived completion.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected a selected-gap closure report because matrix behavior would remain unchanged.
Rejected caller-authored gap status updates because they would bypass Rust-owned selected-gap provenance and acceptance checks.
Rejected loosening the one-decision-per-boundary invariant; closure-driven product_complete is admitted on the later continuation completion boundary.
technical_debt: Runtime product-loop logic remains concentrated in crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs.
M63.1 consumes exact selected gap fingerprints; broader semantic Product DoD gap equivalence remains out of scope.
No-eligible run-session checkpoints now persist post_progress as their start progress so later drives can resume safely after no mutation.
next_capability_rationale: After merge, assess whether M63 can close out or whether a distinct remaining transition is needed for multi-gap closure sequencing.
